description: What the latest run of a site changed against the run before it: the score, rules now passing, rules newly failing, and pages added and removed. Call it after a rescan is done. For a site whose server sends its own counts, "visits" sets people, people an assistant sent and crawler fetches in the week before the run against the week since.
